newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq finishes higher, led by large-caps.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq finishes higher, led by large-caps.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks closed higher on Tuesday, but the rally was largely confined to some scorching gains posted by the top-tier technology names.

The Nasdaq Composite rose about eight points to close unofficially at 1263. In contrast, the Nasdaq 100 index, which includes the 100 largest capitalized stocks on Nasdaq, rose more than 12 points to 806.
Declining issues edged out advancers by 1,640 to 1,528 on volume of more than 486 million shares.
Topping the gainers list was Dell Computer Corp, which surged 8-1/4 to 97-3/4 on more than six million shares in volume. Dell was Nasdaq's fourth most active issue.
The three most active issues all posted solid gains. Intel Corp jumped 5-3/8 to 120-3/4, Microsoft Corp gained 5-1/2 to 155-7/8 and Cisco Systems Inc climbed 1-5/8 to 65.
